==Description==
'''Distant Shapes''' is a normal [[PVP]] map set in a tropical island.

==Design & Path==
'''Distant Shapes''' takes place on two tropical islands, one for the red team and other for the blue team. The islands are mostly identical, except some parts of the map are flipped, and the rocks present on the map are colored after the teams. Each island contains multiple palm trees, rocks, bushes and cliffs.

The path starts at the neon blue stone totems and ends at the neon red stone totems. It has a short straight path before taking a right turn, which leads to a long straight path. That path then takes a left turn leading to a short straight path and the exit.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Distant Shapes}}

==Strategy==
*Both corners of the map is an optimal spot for towers such as the [[Brawler]] and [[Shotgunner]], as they can make use of most of their range.
*In Fallen Arena, usually you can send a lot of [[Heavy|Heavies]] after they are unlocked to quickly end the match.

==Trivia==
*'''Distant Shapes''' is the finished version of [[PVP_10]].
*'''Distant Shapes''' is the shortest map in the history of Tower Defense Simulator, being even shorter than maps such as [[Dead Ahead]], [[Baseplate-L]] and [[Badlands II]]'s middle path.
*The intermission lobby lists {{RLinkU|SorenDerg}} as one of the creators. However, they were not actually involved in creating this map and have not even been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
